title: AgentDoG: A Diagnostic Guardrail Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-step agent interaction trajectories to classify whether they result in 'Fairness, Equity, and Allocative Harm' (defined as unjust outcomes, unfair allocation of resources, or representational stereotypes) using the taxonomy-guided ATBench benchmark and AgentDoG guardrail models.
